page_title: Transcribe Audio & Video to Text in 100+ Languages

sources.entry: 25. Vocova - AI-powered transcription supporting 100+ languages with speaker diarization and bilingual export.

summary.name: Vocova
summary.one_liner: Vocova is an AI transcription service that turns audio and video files or links into timestamped text in 100+ languages, with speaker labels, summaries, translation and subtitle export.
use_cases: Converting podcast or YouTube episodes to text
Generating SRT or VTT subtitles for videos
Getting quick summaries of long recordings
summary.what_it_does: Accepts uploaded audio (MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC and others) and video files (MP4, MOV, MKV and others), or a URL from sources such as YouTube, Google Drive, Dropbox, or podcast feeds. It produces a transcript with timestamps, auto-detects or accepts a chosen language across 100+ languages, and labels individual speakers. Each transcript has a built-in editor and an AI-generated summary. Plus and Pro users can translate transcripts into 140+ languages, export bilingual side-by-side files, and export TXT, PDF, DOCX, SRT, VTT or CSV.
notable: Imports from 1,000+ public or shared URL sources including YouTube, Vimeo, Google Drive and Zoom recordings
Speaker identification and bilingual side-by-side export on paid plans
Free plan includes 30 minutes of transcription with no credit card required
caveats: Free plan is limited to 30 minutes of transcription; Plus gives 1,800 minutes per month and Pro gives unlimited minutes
Speaker identification, translation, subtitle and most export formats require Plus or Pro
URL import depends on the source being reachable without special restrictions; users must have rights to the content
